MaskChildDeclarationV1.description:
Client-declared mask upload intent; asserts no grid or inspection truth.

Anchored to a real sealed reconstruction subject plus one target baseline
DSM artifact.  The ``childKind`` literal keeps this resource distinct from
DSM epochs, reports, and checkpoints.  Declared SHA/size are intent only;
Core re-proves observed bytes after the protected upload seals.
MaskChildDeclarationV1.title: MaskChildDeclarationV1

MaskChildViewV1.description: Declared intent plus the Core-sealed observed manifest (when sealed).
MaskChildViewV1.title: MaskChildViewV1

MaskInspectionFailureRequestV1.description: Fenced worker failure: live lease binding plus one closed reason.
MaskInspectionFailureRequestV1.title: MaskInspectionFailureRequestV1

MaskInspectionFailureViewV1.description: Terminal inspection outcome (never revived, never numeric).
MaskInspectionFailureViewV1.title: MaskInspectionFailureViewV1

MaskInspectionLeaseRequestV1.description:
Server-issued inspection job request: exact byte/subject/anchor identity.

The worker supplies the sealed subject copies Core must bind; Core
resolves the baseline anchor grid itself and returns the expected grid
facts the contained inspector must prove.  No caller grid is accepted.
MaskInspectionLeaseRequestV1.title: MaskInspectionLeaseRequestV1

MaskInspectionLeaseViewV1.description: Fenced inspection job plus the exact expected grid from the anchor.
MaskInspectionLeaseViewV1.title: MaskInspectionLeaseViewV1

MaskInspectionPendingItemV1.description: One announced child with sealed bytes but no sealed manifest yet.
MaskInspectionPendingItemV1.title: MaskInspectionPendingItemV1

MaskInspectionProfileV1.description:
Narrow uint8 binary-mask inspection profile with explicit contained binding.

The contained protocol and runtime binding are explicit inputs: a profile
without them is rejected, and no default is inferred.  The grammar digest
names the separately approved mask grammar; Core must never accept the old
float-DSM grammar digest here.
MaskInspectionProfileV1.title: MaskInspectionProfileV1

MaskInspectionReportRequestV1.description: Fenced narrow report: live lease binding plus sealed worker evidence.
MaskInspectionReportRequestV1.title: MaskInspectionReportRequestV1

MaskInspectionStatusViewV1.description:
Human-readable inspection state: manifest or terminal failure wins.

``PENDING`` means announced without an outcome yet (bytes may still be
unsealed); ``RUNNING`` a live lease; ``COMPLETED`` a sealed manifest;
``REJECTED``/``FAILED`` the terminal worker failure with its reason.
MaskInspectionStatusViewV1.title: MaskInspectionStatusViewV1

MaskObservationMeasurementsV1.description: Contained-runtime observed facts for one binary-mask TIFF, evidence only.
MaskObservationMeasurementsV1.title: MaskObservationMeasurementsV1

MaskObservationReportV1.description: Sealed contained-runtime observation of one mask child artifact.
MaskObservationReportV1.title: MaskObservationReportV1

MaskObservedManifestV1.description:
Core-sealed observed-byte manifest for one mask child resource.

Created by Core only, from the sealed inspection report's observed raster
facts plus the sealed stored bytes.  A caller ``userDeclaredInspection``
claim is never accepted as authority.  The binary convention is fixed:
unsigned 8-bit, single band, ``0`` retains and ``1`` excludes; any NoData
representation is a blocker recorded as ``NONE`` only when the worker
proved no NoData tag and no masked pixels exist.
MaskObservedManifestV1.title: MaskObservedManifestV1

MaskSealViewV1.description: Worker-sealed manifest receipt (no declaration re-read is required).
MaskSealViewV1.title: MaskSealViewV1

MaskSourceContextViewV1.description:
Core-resolved declaration anchor for one sealed AP source identity.

Sealed source copies Core rechecks at declare/seal/bind time; this view
creates no admission and asserts no numeric result.  The Console builds
only opaque ids plus hash/size from it — the grid always comes from the
Core anchor, never from user input.  ``maxMaskBytes`` is the explicit
native envelope cap (``min(maxInputBytes, maxStreamedBytes)``); no
retention is guessed.  Provisional sources stay provisional here.
MaskSourceContextViewV1.title: MaskSourceContextViewV1

MaskUploadGrantRequestV1.description: Bounded raw-upload grant intent; Core mints the server object key.
MaskUploadGrantRequestV1.title: MaskUploadGrantRequestV1

MaskUploadGrantViewV1.description: Issued grant: id plus expiry only.  No object key, path, or URL leaves Core.
MaskUploadGrantViewV1.title: MaskUploadGrantViewV1

MaskUploadSealViewV1.description: Sealed upload receipt: observed byte identity only, no path.
MaskUploadSealViewV1.title: MaskUploadSealViewV1

MaskedAdmissionV3.description: Numeric-free suitability decision for one exact masked calculation.
MaskedAdmissionV3.title: MaskedAdmissionV3

MaskedBytesSliceViewV1.description: Bounded protected-bytes slice: canonical base64, never a path or URL.
MaskedBytesSliceViewV1.title: MaskedBytesSliceViewV1

MaskedCalculationCreateRequestV1.description:
Create a V3 calculation from Core-resolved source evidence plus mask child.

Only digests and opaque ids travel here.  Core constructs the masked
identity itself from the current AP assessment plus the current sealed
mask manifest via ``bind_identity``; no V2 numeric result is required
and none is accepted as the masked result key.
MaskedCalculationCreateRequestV1.title: MaskedCalculationCreateRequestV1

MaskedCalculationCreatedViewV1.description: Issued V3 calculation: fenced identity plus its admission.
MaskedCalculationCreatedViewV1.title: MaskedCalculationCreatedViewV1

MaskedCalculationDetailViewV1.description: Current V3 view: fresh disposition, admission, and numeric report when available.
MaskedCalculationDetailViewV1.title: MaskedCalculationDetailViewV1

MaskedCalculationMutationViewV1.description: Fenced worker mutation receipt: request plus its live attempt.
MaskedCalculationMutationViewV1.title: MaskedCalculationMutationViewV1

MaskedCalculationPendingItemV1.description: One Core-bound V3 calculation awaiting or reclaimable by a worker.
MaskedCalculationPendingItemV1.title: MaskedCalculationPendingItemV1

MaskedCoverageWitnessV3.description: Lossless bounded masks: original, mask-excluded, effective, common, unavailable.
MaskedCoverageWitnessV3.title: MaskedCoverageWitnessV3

MaskedDeltaSourceRefV1.description:
Late-publication handoff: source identity plus mask child only.

The parent delta route resolves every grid/profile/registry fact itself
through the Core-bound masked identity and the sealed mask manifest
behind its own new publication lease.  Caller grid/profile truth is
never accepted here.
MaskedDeltaSourceRefV1.title: MaskedDeltaSourceRefV1

MaskedExecutionAttemptV3.description: A fenced masked-worker ownership interval for exactly one V3 authorization.
MaskedExecutionAttemptV3.title: MaskedExecutionAttemptV3

MaskedExecutionAuthorizationV3.description: Core-selected V3 limits bound to a current admission plus signed activation.
MaskedExecutionAuthorizationV3.title: MaskedExecutionAuthorizationV3

MaskedVolumeCalculationFailureV3.description: A typed immutable attempt outcome that contains no partial numeric result.
MaskedVolumeCalculationFailureV3.title: MaskedVolumeCalculationFailureV3

MaskedVolumeCalculationReportV3.description: Fenced worker report that wraps, but cannot alter, masked numeric content.
MaskedVolumeCalculationReportV3.title: MaskedVolumeCalculationReportV3

MaskedVolumeImpactV3.description: Unmasked-vs-masked consequence; unknown stays null, never zero-invented.
MaskedVolumeImpactV3.title: MaskedVolumeImpactV3

MaskedVolumeNumericResultV3.description: Identity-bound masked numeric content; the V2 leaf is reused, never extended.
MaskedVolumeNumericResultV3.title: MaskedVolumeNumericResultV3

RelativeVolumeMetricsV2.description: Finite cut/fill arithmetic for the one fixed profile.
RelativeVolumeMetricsV2.title: RelativeVolumeMetricsV2

ResourceEnvelopeV1.description: Configured finite worker limits; values are policy data, never client input.
ResourceEnvelopeV1.title: ResourceEnvelopeV1

SealedExternalSubjectV1.description: Exact external revision identity; Core later proves it is in caller scope.
SealedExternalSubjectV1.title: SealedExternalSubjectV1
